$comment: TEMPLATE for aegis.config.local.json — per-machine overrides. Copy to
aegis.config.local.json (gitignored) and delete every key you do NOT need
to change. It is DEEP-MERGED over aegis.config.json, so overriding one
surface root does not require restating the others.
Easier: run `node cli.js setup`, which detects these paths for you.
Env-var equivalents (highest precedence, no file needed):
Read-only access to the LIVE deployed ruleset via the Firebase Rules API.
Aegis stores only the PATH — the key itself is never copied, never
committed and never sent anywhere but Google. Without it the live axis
goes dark and every command says so instead of guessing.
Needs the 'Firebase Rules Viewer' role (roles/firebaserules.viewer) at
minimum; a full admin key works but is more than this needs.
